question: The frequency of a sound wave is 50 {Hz} . How much time will it take to complete one wave?
solution: The correct answer is __**0.02 seconds**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The **frequency** of a wave is defined as the number of oscillations or cycles the wave completes in one second. It is measured in **Hertz (Hz)**. • The **time period (T)** of a wave is the time taken to complete one oscillation. It is the reciprocal of the frequency (f). This relationship is mathematically expressed as: **T = 1/f** • In the given question, the frequency of the sound wave is **50 Hz**. Substituting this into the formula: **T = 1/f = 1/50 = 0.02 seconds.** • Thus, the **time period** of the wave is **0.02 seconds**, indicating that the wave completes one cycle in this duration. • Hence, the correct answer is **0.02 seconds**__.
